Roles and permissions

Staff submit and view their own requests. Assigned managers approve or return them. Finance sees approved financial items and HR sees leave records.

Build prompt

Build “Staff Expense, Purchase & Leave Approvals” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Use separate forms for expense, purchase and leave. Require receipts when the expense rule calls for one, route purchases by amount and log every decision. Block self-approval. Staff submit and view their own requests. Assigned managers approve or return them. Finance sees approved financial items and HR sees leave records. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

A $600 purchase crosses a sample $500 approval threshold and goes to the director. Its requester cannot approve it. Finance sees the approved purchase and cannot access a colleague’s leave details.
